SELECT
    corr(total_downtime_minutes, total_sales_amount) AS outage_sales_correlation,
    count() AS store_day_count,
    avg(total_downtime_minutes) AS avg_daily_downtime_minutes,
    avg(total_sales_amount) AS avg_daily_sales_amount
FROM
(
    SELECT
        coalesce(s.DateKey, o.DateKey) AS DateKey,
        coalesce(s.StoreKey, o.StoreKey) AS StoreKey,
        ifNull(o.total_downtime_minutes, 0) AS total_downtime_minutes,
        ifNull(s.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            DateKey,
            StoreKey,
            sum(SalesAmount) AS total_sales_amount
        FROM retail.FactSales
        GROUP BY DateKey, StoreKey
    ) AS s
    FULL OUTER JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            DateKey,
            StoreKey,
            sum(ifNull(DownTime, 0)) AS total_downtime_minutes
        FROM retail.FactITSLA
        GROUP BY DateKey, StoreKey
    ) AS o
        ON s.DateKey = o.DateKey
       AND s.StoreKey = o.StoreKey
)
